No changes detected in this release.  
- Version bump only; no updates to files or documentation.
- Behavior, features, and API remain unchanged from the previous release.

Version 1.0.3 Changelog

- No file or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Functionality and documentation remain as in the previous version.

**Major update with new features and expanded blockchain support:**

- Now supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana wallet generation and management.
- Local wallet and private key creation; no sensitive data sent to MoltPay.
- Integrated ORA token rewards—register wallets to claim 333 ORA tokens (withdrawal minimum: 3333 ORA).
- Added detailed API reference and transaction management endpoints.
- Enhanced security model and local data storage.
- Requires displaying generated wallet QR codes to your owner after setup.
